name: Dranosh'ar Blockade
summary: The lowlands immediately south of Orgrimmar's towering timber gates serve as the primary threshold into the Horde's capital. Flanked by rugged canyon walls, this open approach connects the red wastes of Durotar directly to the fortress city. It remains an active thoroughfare where arriving travelers, supply wagons, and watchful city grunts converge.

sections.title: The Gates of the Capital
sections.body: Before the towering wooden bulwarks of Orgrimmar lies an open apron of red earth carving into the northern bluffs of Durotar. Standing between nearby boar homesteads like the Rocktusk Farm and the shadowy crevices of Skull Rock to the east, this clearing provides an unobstructed killing field for the city's watchtowers. In these early years following the Third War, the valley is not heavily fortified by outer perimeter walls, relying instead on high canyon geography and the imposing might of Orgrimmar's main gate to turn back any hostile intruders.

sections.title: A Gathering of War and Trade
sections.body: Because all major land traffic from Sen'jin Village, Razor Hill, and the southern plains must funnel through this northern corridor, the grounds see constant activity. Grunts drill outside the gates under the desert sun, keeping the peace among caravan drivers and wayward peons. With the Alliance lurking across the sea in Theramore and quilboar tribes roaming the interior, the approach is treated as the Horde's front line, where vigilant guards ensure no threat slips into the valley unnoticed.

faq.q: What is this area outside Orgrimmar used for?
faq.answer: This open approach directly south of the city's gates functions as a primary staging ground, patrol route, and trade artery. Caravans, travelers, and returning warriors gather here before entering Orgrimmar, overseen by watchful Horde grunts.

The main line of defense is the massive timber and iron gate of Orgrimmar itself, built directly into the sheer mountain gap. The exterior grounds rely on watchtowers, roving guards, and natural canyon bottlenecks rather than extensive outer fortifications.

faq.q: What landmarks border the valley outside the gates?
faq.answer: To the west sit local swine herders at Rocktusk Farm and Jaggedswine Farm, while the rugged, cultist-infested caverns of Skull Rock flank the eastern ridges along the coastline.

The land belongs firmly to the Horde, under the direct jurisdiction of Warchief Thrall and the Orgrimmar garrison. Grunts maintain round-the-clock watches to prevent centaur, quilboar, or Alliance incursions from threatening the capital.

angles.text: The ground outside Orgrimmar's gates is the threshold to safety in Durotar, marking the heart of the modern Horde and the domain of Warchief Thrall.
The open expanse outside the gate serves as an enduring training ground where young orcs and seasoned grunts test their mettle under the blazing sun.
